text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As part of her PR activities, Curren Chan 
was set to be interviewed by a web media 
outlet. It seems she shares some history 
with the reporter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once the interview actually began, the 
reporter repeatedly asked rude questions 
in an attempt to expose Curren Chan's true 
colors.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Curren Chan flatly rejected the 
reporter's assertion that "racing is just 
play." She then spoke sincerely about her 
true feelings toward racing—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She displayed brilliant charm, winning 
over the reporter and getting them to 
admit she was cute. As a result, when the 
article was published later...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan's heartfelt feelings resonated 
with the crowd, even managing to overturn 
the ill rumors spread by those who, like 
the reporter, doubted her dedication.
